result.scope: synthetic LoRA file-backed IO/session controls only; no LoRA arithmetic or full inference

tests.name: Capabilities distinguish LoRA weight IO from unapplied full inference
Header inspection identifies actual paired stored tensors without full hash
Two stage bindings preserve explicit zero strength and hash original bytes
F16 BF16 F32 reads return exact owned stored bytes with finite range evidence
Host metadata is independent of returned load and list mutations
Invalid declaration failed replacement and expected-hash failure preserve old binding
Raw source reads preserve file identity and enforce range bounds
Wrong stage foreign handle and invalid tensor ranges are rejected
Cancelled replacement and Worker regeneration keep earlier binding readable
Busy control operations do not mutate bindings and a newer revision supersedes pending replacement
Successful replacement invalidates the earlier opaque handle
Stale terminated Worker success cannot commit even when request identity is reused
Explicit MessagePort loads files lists bindings and returns binary source and tensor bytes
Numeric payload validation is performed on tensor ranges and not falsely claimed by loading
Unload clears only the matching stage while predict and sample remain NOT_READY
Dispose settles in-flight work and refuses subsequent LoRA access
